One copy only. Checked live on 2026-10-03 while building this ticket:
`/home/col/.claude-max2/` has NO hooks/ directory of its own (unlike
`agents` and `skills`, which are symlinks back to `/home/col/.claude/`,

settings.json already references its hook commands with the literal
path `bash ~/.claude/hooks/<script>.sh` (e.g. block-secret-reads.sh,
mirror-error-ledger.sh), which resolves to `/home/col/.claude/hooks/`
on both seats because HOME is shared. So the new `.sh` lives in exactly
one place, and the snippet's command line below is correct verbatim for
both settings.json files — no `.claude-max2/hooks/` copy is needed.
Do NOT edit either live settings.json as part of this ticket (T6) — this
file only stages the snippet for Colin's own paste-in on his go.
The matcher below covers every tool this hook knows how to describe
(Bash/Edit/Write/Read/Glob/Grep); anything else falls through to the
script's own `*) description="$tool"` fallback rather than being
excluded by the matcher, so widening this matcher later needs no script
change. Do not remove or reorder either seat's existing PostToolUse
entries when pasting this one in — append it to the array.
